title: Together AI Project API key (tgp_v1_): must be flagged
summary: Synthetic Together AI Project API key (tgp_v1_) values built to the documented format appear in 15 inputs across 12 carrier types. Each input records the exact byte range of the secret.
rationale: A credential that a scanner misses in an ordinary carrier is leaked. Carriers differ in quoting, delimiters and surrounding text, so a hit on one carrier does not show coverage of another.

expectation.rationale: Synthetic value matches the pinned lexical format contract. Provider issuance, payload/checksum validity and liveness are not claimed.
